defects.title: Multiple SUBMISSION_XP on same Denver day (SC-005 B3)
reproductionSteps: Create two Count It submissions with Activity Date 2026-06-01 on Testing3
Poll Source Key SUBMISSION_XP|{each submission id}
defects.expectedResult: Product decision: at most one counted shooting XP day (engine) OR explicit per-submission XP
